title: el rol del ἔρως en el ascenso filosófico del fedro: de la belleza corpórea a la amistad filosófica
core_idea: Clarify the role of ἔρως in the philosophical ascent to the form of beauty in Plato's Phaedrus by distinguishing the two concepts of ἔρως in Socrates' first and second speeches, analyzing the relationship between them, and examining how corporeal beauty awakens a divine ἔρως (as μανία divina) and its place in subordinating disordered inclinations to the pursuit of the wise, good, and beautiful, with attention to the social dimension of philosophical life in friendship.
tldr: Investigates how two uses of ἔρως in the Phaedrus relate and how corporeal beauty can awaken a divine ἔρως (divine madness), exploring its role in the ascent toward the form of beauty and the communal (friendship) character of philosophical life.
